name: Atlantis (STS-86)
about: Atlantis (STS-86) (1997-055A), a crewed vehicle (OV-104), launched 1997 Sep 26. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1997 Sep 28), held fixed
docked to A05709; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
